mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy shifts toward accommodation.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and reducing valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%, or Rank IC remains negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 in 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing market expansion (HOUST > 1200) and strong retail sales (RSAFS > 450,000) accelerate consumer spending, increasing corporate revenue visibility and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 450,000, or Rank IC for joint signal falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicate weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1200 thousand units signal robust construction activity that stimulates consumer spending and business investment, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing output contraction (INDPRO < 105) during supply shocks reduces corporate capacity utilization and future earnings potential, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 105, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent price pressures that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC remains negative over any 3-year rolling window.
